    neighbors = row['neighbor']
    neighbors = neighbors.split(', ')
    neighbors = [n for n in neighbors if n in data['borough'].values]
    if neighbors:
        avg = np.mean(data.loc[data['borough'].isin(neighbors), 'Waste_value'])

# Compute citywide average
citywide_avg = np.mean(data['Waste_value'])

# Compute residuals
residuals = data['Waste_value'] - citywide_avg

weighted_residuals = {}
for index, row in adjacency.iterrows():
    borough = row['borough']
    neighbors = row['neighbor']
    neighbors = neighbors.split(', ')
    neighbors = [n for n in neighbors if n in data['borough'].values]
    if neighbors:
        weights = len(neighbors)
        weighted_avg = np.mean([residuals.loc[residuals.index == n] for n in neighbors])
        weighted_residuals[borough] = weighted_avg * weights / len(neighbors)
